title: fix(pm): roster Build UI Deps in check-expected-skips
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HKXqdKnjaP2BxDmaNPtUK2)_
Fixes #26111
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

`scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` gains one roster row: `Build UI Deps` (ci.yml job `ui-deps`), on the `UI_CONSUMERS_GATE` shape (`ui_tree`, `ui`, `ui_consumers`) the `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` rows already carry. The job's `if:` is the union of the four ui jobs' conditions, so it skips by design on every head whose diff touches neither a `ui/` path nor a package objectui consumes; the queue reads the same filter against its `base_sha` and main's hourly run widens it. Without the row the landing check read that skip as a filter miss (exit 4) on every non-ui PR.

The row is pinned against the live workflow by the existing `--self-test` audit (job exists, carries the row's name, carries an `if:` spelling all three outputs, each output widened with `|| 'true'`). Four self-test cases are added for it: the row sits on the same gate object as `Type Check UI`; a deleted `ui-deps` job still reds the row; a `ui-deps` `if:` that dropped its `ui_consumers` half reds it; a skipped `Build UI Deps` beside a success judges exit 0. Two header comments now say five ui jobs instead of four.

## Evidence

- Before (origin/main `fbb75998`): `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 25973` reads `unexpected skips (1) — outside the roster: Build UI Deps … filter-miss` and `VERDICT … outside main's roster (exit 4)`.
- After (head `50b0a988`), offline on the same head's check-runs payload (PR 25973 head `1ccff6f5`, 40 runs) through `--check-runs-json`: `VERDICT check-expected-skips: OK — 13 skipped check-run(s), every one in the roster (exit 0)`; `Build UI Deps [ci.yml › ui-deps]` is listed under expected. A live `--pr 25973` from this branch answers exit 3 by design (the roster in hand is not main's until this lands); the card's live criterion is read on main after landing.
- `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --self-test`: `173 cases pass`, exit 0.
- Ablation (committed first, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): renaming the row reds 5 of 173 cases, the live audit and all four new ones.

## Gates (head `50b0a988`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 33 families for this one-file diff; all 33 ran locally with exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (1917 fast-tier cases pass) and `pnpm check:pm-expected-skips`. `--ran` reconciliation: `33 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed file: exit 0. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI (`Lint & Repo Gates`).

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` pins the `dispatch-gates: self-test-reads` declaration in this file by line number (`check-expected-skips.mjs:137`). The first push added a header line above it and the census case went red; the second commit keeps the header the same length, so the line is unchanged. Any later edit above that line in this file has to move the pin with it. Carrier: none. Noted, not filed.
